cases.name: batch baseline restore, on a throwaway repo: patch saved, batch files back to HEAD, created files deleted, a file modified before the batch left as is and listed
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/restore-{{SID}}; W=$R.jsonl; rm -rf $R $W; mkdir -p $R/src/A $R/tests/T && cd $R && git init -q && git config user.name eval && git config user.email eval@example.invalid && git config commit.gpgsign false && printf 'v0
' > src/A/clean.cs && printf 'v0
' > src/A/dirty.cs && printf 'v0
' > tests/T/gone.cs && git add -A && git commit -qm init && printf 'start
' > src/A/dirty.cs && printf 'early
' > src/A/early.cs && cd {{ROOT}} && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py snapshot $W F1 --root $R >/dev/null && printf 'batch
' >> $R/src/A/clean.cs && printf 'batch
' > $R/src/A/early.cs && mkdir -p $R/src/New && printf 'new
' > $R/src/New/made.cs && rm $R/tests/T/gone.cs && out=$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py restore $W F1 --root $R --save $R.patch) && echo "$(cat $R/src/A/clean.cs)|$(cat $R/src/A/dirty.cs)|$(cat $R/src/A/early.cs)|$(cat $R/tests/T/gone.cs)|$(test -e $R/src/New && echo kept || echo pruned)|$(grep -c '^+batch' $R.patch)|$(grep -c '^+++ b/src/New/made.cs' $R.patch)|$out"

expect.stdout: v0|start|batch|v0|pruned|1|1|restored: 2 file(s), deleted: 1, left (modified before the batch): src/A/early.cs

cases.name: batch baseline snapshot stores hashes only, never a file content, and a second snapshot of the batch keeps the first
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/snap-{{SID}}; W=$R.jsonl; rm -rf $R $W; mkdir -p $R/src && cd $R && git init -q && git config user.name eval && git config user.email eval@example.invalid && git config commit.gpgsign false && printf 'v0\n' > src/a.cs && git add -A && git commit -qm init && printf 'secret-user-content\n' > src/a.cs && cd {{ROOT}} && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py snapshot $W F1 --root $R >/dev/null && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py snapshot $W F1 --root $R && echo "content=$(grep -c secret-user-content $W)|lines=$(wc -l < $W | tr -d ' ')"
